import html from typing import List # Example template. In practice, this would be defined elsewhere in the codebase. USER_POST_FORMAT = """

{title}

Posted by: {author_name}

{body}
{tags}
""" def render_forum_post( author_name: str, title: str, body_content: str, tag_list: List[str] ) -> str: """ Generate a secure HTML representation of a forum post. Parameters ---------- author_name : str Identifier of the post's creator. title : str Heading of the user's post. body_content : str Primary content of the user's post. tag_list : List[str] Sequence of tags associated with the post. Returns ------- str XSS‑protected HTML string of the forum post. """ # Escape all user-controlled input to prevent XSS safe_author = html.escape(author_name, quote=True) safe_title = html.escape(title, quote=True) safe_body = html.escape(body_content) # Wrap each tag in a and escape it safe_tags = "".join( f'{html.escape(tag, quote=True)}' for tag in tag_list ) # Fill the template with escaped values rendered = USER_POST_FORMAT.format( title=safe_title, author_name=safe_author, body=safe_body, tags=safe_tags ) return rendered.strip()
